caption_L1: This is a line graph titled Volume of U.S. exports of trade goods to Africa from 1997 to 2019 (in billion U.S. dollars). Along the y-axis, Export volume in billion U.S. dollars is plotted. On the x-axis, Year is measured.
caption_L2L3: There has been an upward trend in exports over the years. The volume of exports varies throughout the years. The greatest decease in exports occurred around 2015. Exports occurred the most around 2014. Since around 2006 exports have not been lower than 20 billion.
